1.

Holy, holy Lord God! Earth and heavens at Thy command Out of darkness’ secrecy Were brought forth in glory; Fair, perfect, pure and good Creation before Thee stood, Singing with sweet sound: Holy, holy Lord God!

2.

Holy, holy Lord God! Though in sin against Thy commands Man has corrupted himself, Thou yet remainest holy, And in Thy mercy Thy glory shines most brightly; Therefore the bride of the Lamb sings: Holy, holy Lord God!

3.

Holy, holy Lord God! Creation in festal array Shall at last be adorned And raise the song of victory. All the redeemed gathering Shall sing throughout eternity To the sound of the golden harps: Holy, holy Lord God!
